# Incident report (draft, generated by an AI agent)

*Generated 2026-11-07 22:46 UTC by `anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5` in 2 tool steps, cost $0.0027. A human must review it before it is shared.*

**Alert:** Checkout Overview alert: elevated errors and/or latency on service `checkout` (thresholds: 5xx ratio > 5% or p95 latency > 2s for 5 minutes). Find out why.

## Summary

Checkout /checkout route is returning HTTP 500s at ~61% rate, caused by deploy v2026.11.07-2 (sha 0c900be, 'Apply promo discounts in checkout pricing', by dana) raising TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable. Errors began within a minute of the deploy. Only /checkout is affected; /orders/{order_id} and /products are healthy. Latency is well under the 2s threshold; the alert fired on the 5xx ratio condition.

## Impact

/checkout 5xx ratio ~61% (threshold 5%), so most checkout attempts fail for the duration of the incident. /orders and /products unaffected. Payment provider errors negligible. Severity at least SEV2 per the bad-deploy mapping; escalate to SEV1 if payment failures exceed 20% or checkout is fully down, which needs business-side confirmation.
